---
title: "Compare PACs"
---

{{< include _notice.qmd >}}

Each bar is one corporate PAC. Segments show where its direct candidate contributions went, by the candidate's
HRC score bin (118th Congress). Use *Share of PAC total* to compare PACs of different sizes.

```{python}
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, ".")
import altair as alt
from pals_site import BINS, CYCLE_LABELS, NOTICE, OFFICE_OPTIONS, bin_color, load

summary = load()["summary"].copy()
summary["cycle_label"] = summary["cycle"].map(CYCLE_LABELS)
summary["bin_order"] = summary["score_bin"].map({b: i for i, b in enumerate(BINS)})
cycle_p = alt.param(name="cycle", value="All", bind=alt.binding_radio(
    options=["All", "2024", "2026"], labels=["Both cycles", "2024", "2026"], name="Cycle: "))
office_p = alt.param(name="office", value="All", bind=alt.binding_radio(
    options=OFFICE_OPTIONS, labels=["All", "House", "Senate"], name="Office: "))
measure_p = alt.param(name="measure", value="Share of PAC total", bind=alt.binding_radio(
    options=["Dollars", "Share of PAC total", "Candidates"], name="Show: "))
axis_expr = ("measure == 'Dollars' ? '$' + format(datum.value, ',.0f') : measure == 'Candidates' ? "
             "format(datum.value, ',d') : format(datum.value, '.0%')")

chart = (
    alt.Chart(summary)
    .transform_filter("datum.cycle == cycle && datum.office == office")
    .transform_calculate(value="measure == 'Dollars' ? datum.dollars : measure == 'Share of PAC total' ? datum.share : datum.candidates")
    .mark_bar()
    .encode(
        y=alt.Y("pac:N", title=None, sort=alt.SortField("pac")),
        x=alt.X("value:Q", title="Direct contributions", stack="zero", axis=alt.Axis(labelExpr=axis_expr)),
        color=bin_color(),
        order=alt.Order("bin_order:Q"),
        tooltip=[
            alt.Tooltip("pac:N", title="PAC"),
            alt.Tooltip("cycle_label:N", title="Cycle"),
            alt.Tooltip("office:N", title="Office"),
            alt.Tooltip("score_bin:N", title="HRC score bin"),
            alt.Tooltip("dollars:Q", title="Dollars", format="$,.0f"),
            alt.Tooltip("candidates:Q", title="Candidates"),
            alt.Tooltip("share:Q", title="Share of PAC total", format=".1%"),
        ],
    )
    .add_params(cycle_p, office_p, measure_p)
    .properties(width="container", height=260,
                title=alt.TitleParams("Direct contributions by PAC and HRC score bin", subtitle=NOTICE,
                                      subtitleColor="#444", fontSize=15, anchor="start"))
)
chart
```

PACs with no direct candidate contributions for the selected cycle and office (such as Anthropic) show an empty row. *Candidates* counts distinct people per PAC.

## Share of each PAC's dollars, both cycles

```{python}
from IPython.display import HTML
s = summary[(summary["cycle"] == "All") & (summary["office"] == "All")]
piv = s.pivot(index="score_bin", columns="pac", values="share").reindex(BINS)
html = piv.map(lambda v: f"{v:.1%}").to_html(classes="table table-sm", border=0)
HTML(f'<div class="table-responsive">{html}</div><p><small>{NOTICE}</small></p>')
```
